definition: Book A's last sentence on this page says the ya of معي is open wherever it occurs, provided no hamza qat' with a fatha follows. The corpus spells the opposite: closed everywhere except before a fatha hamza (9:83 and 67:28 in the Kufian count).
limitations: Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
Only Book A is cited; the printed page is where the section begins and needs proofreading.

Not arbitrated: the sentence contradicts both the corpus spelling and the book's own classes 1 and 6 on pp.48-50, which give the reverse. Each occurrence reports what the corpus spells and nothing is chosen.

conditions.description: The word is معي, with or without a one-letter prefix.
